never: send the review link only to customers who scored 4 or 5, or send a low scorer anywhere else
hold or skip an ask because of a score, a predicted mood or anything the customer said
send anything to a customer after they reply, or a second reminder
write, draft, suggest or post a review, or reply to one on Google
offer a discount, voucher, draw or anything else in exchange for a review
ask a customer who opted out, on any later job
ask about a job the job system does not show as finished
stays_with_person: answering every Google review, good and bad
calling a customer who scored 1 to 3
closing a callback, settling a dispute or closing a complaint in the job system
writing the message, the wait, the reminder interval and the window
taking a customer off the opt-out list, only if they ask

provider_block.job: every customer asked for a Google review the same way once the job is finished, with low scores sent to the owner to call

with_us.note: No hosted product. Reading the job's status, linked callbacks and invoice state from ServiceM8, Simpro, Fergus, Jobber or AroFlo at the moment of sending, and bringing SMS replies and STOPs back from the carrier, run on the business's own job system and messaging account and are quoted as a scoped build.

checks.title: The ask starts when the job system says the job is finished
The ask waits the written time after the job is finished
Every customer gets the same message and the same review link
A job that is not really finished is held, with the reason
The job is read again at the moment of sending
When the hold clears, the same ask goes the same way
One ask per customer, however many jobs they had
Asked only on the channel on record, and a STOP is for good
One reminder if nothing comes back, then stop
A low score tells the owner to call, and changes nothing for the customer
It never makes up, rewards or answers a review
Every ask, reminder, reply, hold and alert is on the record by job
